title: Wonderful.
text: Wonderful experience. The tour guide was very informative and had a great personality. Highly recommend.
author: Sally_Y

title: The highlight of my time in Granada
text: I did this tour by myself and it was absolutely the highlight of my time in Granada. VoiceMap is a fantastic way to experience a city without getting lost and without needing to constantly pull out your phone. Ben’s tours in particular are fantastic. I love the way he fills up all the spaces between key places with all sorts of information you’d never hear anywhere else- things like pointing out repurposed Roman columns used to build a fountain or the person a street was named after.
author: Casey C

title: Not to be missed!
text: We absolutely loved this tour! The perfect weather helped. The sights are amazing and the audio guide and map worked perfectly. The narration is clear and interesting and with just enough information. The walk/climb to the start of the tour is the hardest part - you could always take a car, bus etc. if you don't want a long uphill walk before you get started. The tour itself has uphills and downhills but very manageable.
author: joegW4454ZY

title: please do this, at your own pace and leisure
text: well done self guided tour. very informative in history, arts food .and you do it at your pace since you will climb a lot. The interactive map is well constructed and can be reset if you need to take a break.
author: Randip_S
